reviews.text: Every single person was so kind and helpful! I was late and they still took care of my cat. They were knowledgeable and offered options without any pressure. We got a needs taken care of with great care!
We appreciate your excellent rating! Thank you, and we hope to see you again soon.

Well it was my first time there and it was just kinda unorganized. It’s all so expensive and when asking questions the answers were very vague. Most of the bordatello oral shot ended up on the floor and I thought I still have to pay for that and how much did she actually absorb. She had an ear infection and it seemed to be pretty simple but ended up doing the drops for treatment since my pup likes to swim this will apparently allow her not to wait as long. The gal at the front desk looked like she needed some help up there nothing against her personally but my account wasn’t sinking to discount my visit two people on hold one person behind me. Then she was just sitting there with the bag of drops and I had to get them myself from behind the computer because she didn’t hand them to me. It was just ok.

Absolutely horrifying what I had to deal with. Been using this vetco over 5+years. Dr Camp retired. Now it is absolutely bad. I went through hell for a prescription after I spend $129 every other month. Dr messed up writing the RX and wanted it to be my problem when all along they just needed to call the pharmacy. This is a medication they charge $60 for at the vet and it's $4 at my pharmacy. I realized today I am just a $$$ sign to them. Now I will be finding a local vet. Done with the corporate guys!! Terrible service at Happy Valley location. I wish it wasn't like this after all these years.
Natasha at the Avondale location did solve my issue after several hours of getting the run around and hung up on. But I appreciate her help!
Unfortunately still finding a more caring veterinarian

Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
The vet was condescending and unpleasant. Dr. G. Made me feel like a bad pet owner.

Front desk staff are disinterested at best, taking way too long to check in/out patients. Pricing is not transparent at all - I came in for the second Lepto shot, was not informed that I was going to be charged AGAIN for a shot package I believed I had already purchased the first visit; "estimate" contained errors because the system can't account for Vital Premier clients so you are asked to sign something that is not correct; even though we were only there for the second round of shots, Vet proceeded to do full work up as though they would be paid for it; spent about a hour for what should have been a quick in and out. Overall not impressed and will be looking for other "routine" visit options in the future.

Everyone in staff was very rude to be except one sweet lady, who you could tell even felt awkward in the room with the vet because of what I was being told and the tone in which I was told, I wasn’t greater since I entered and I was treated poorly since that before I even had a chance to speak, the store was unorganized and I had to go back and forward bc of the products being in the wrong areas and I brought that to a workers attention, she ignored that completely didn’t offer help or anything so I said I’d take back the wrong one and get a different one, trying to be nice and maybe flip the tone of the whole experience around, but nope I was basically ignored and just figured it out myself, still got the wrong thing even tho it was labeled right ( I checked the tags) I paid 70 for something listed as 35, I called the 1-800 number to bring the issue up and they promised an update it’s been a week never heard back, the vet who is supposed to be the professional the reason I went willing to pay $80+ of my hard earned money told me my very clearly 8+ week old kittens were 5 weeks old “100%” I’ve had the kittens for 3 weeks which would mean they were 2 weeks when I got them, but they look exactly the same now as they did when I got them they had all their teeth and full grown ears run and play with all their energy eat perfectly all foods, I stated this she completely disregarded it just acted as tho it was never said, at the end of the appointment she asked if I had questions I said yes I do give me one second without even a breath she says okay well then that’s all, there was so many more things that happened throughout the whole day, I do not understand the hostility I was shown, I’m a very sweet and well mannered person, I never ever complain but it really bugged me how every single person I spoke to was so incredibly rude and for absolutely no reason at all.

This place is a joke!! My dog is sick and the appointment has been scheduled for a week
I get a call the day before saying we don't have enough time to discuss the concerns with a doctor. So they cancelled the appointment. YOU ARE TERRIBLE!!!!

The doctor and staff were all very nice. Other than the computer system crashing which is out of their control.  The doctor did all she could for him but he still passed away in the night. 😭😩🐶💔. Our hearts are broken but we knew we did all we could for lil Meiko.
It was so nice the Dr called me back when she received the message he passed
Thank you everyone for caring about our lil baby boy
took care of my baby so well
Very pleased with the service and staff. Highly recommended.

The staff are very friendly, knowledgeable and caring. The doctors are very professional and explain your options in details so that you can understand your options. They also provide a summary of charges from a low end to a high-end price so that you're not surprised of any of the charges. They even call to check in to make sure everything's going well with your fur baby couple of days after their procedures. I would highly recommend them. I have been there several times with my furbaby and have always been extremely satisfied with the service and hospitality that they provide.

I recently brought in a very young rescued kitten for an urgent visit, and unfortunately my experience was extremely frustrating.

Before the appointment, I originally scheduled for Saturday but then moved it to Friday due to my kitten’s condition. I even called ahead to confirm the updated appointment. However, when I arrived, I was told I did not have an appointment and that I had come on the wrong day. I explained the situation and that I had already confirmed it, which made the interaction confusing and stressful when I was already worried about my kitten.

While the staff did provide medication, the overall communication and level of support during the visit were lacking. I had to repeatedly ask basic questions, including the kitten’s estimated age and medication dosage, instead of being clearly guided through next steps.

I was also told that my kitten was “most likely going to die” in a very direct manner, without much explanation or reassurance. This was extremely difficult to hear and did not feel like a compassionate way to communicate in such a sensitive situation.

I understand that neonatal cases can be uncertain, but clearer communication, better organization, and a more empathetic approach would have made a significant difference.

I appreciate that my kitten was seen and treated, but overall the experience added unnecessary stress during an already difficult time.

This stupid place is a scammer. They charged me for something I was informed it was paid for at my first appointment. I have been calling for a month and they have yet to give me a refund or anything. DO NOT GO HERE, they will sell packages to you for a high price then charge you extra without telling you first. If I could sue, I would because all they do is take your money.

My cat just had a dental at Vetco on Happy Valley. After reading MANY reviews on Reddit testifying to their bad experiences with other Vetcos, I was a bit uncertain. Rest assured, however, all staff has been nothing but exceptional. Dr. Campagnolo was fantastic and I felt immediately at ease when I arrived for the appointment. It was much less than quoted (I also have vital pet premier which gave me a discount) and my cat’s recovery was seamless. Very pleased and very grateful for Vetco on Happy Valley.
We appreciate your excellent rating! Thank you, and we hope to see you again soon.
Dr.  Camp was amazing with my little dog.  He gave my pet personalized care and made sure he was comfortable.
Everyone was very nice and professional.  No hard sells.

very disappointed with their service unfortunately. i have came to this location before to treat my pup for the same thing as last time. she received the same treatment as she had before in the past and somehow got charged an additional $100. facility was also extremely grotesque this time as well. i would strongly recommend another vetco for your pup.
They took great care of my cat that was dealing with some digestive issues. Tried to find the best and most cost effective way to diagnose and treat him. Highly recommend!
The lady at front desk was super nice, very nice and very helpful.   Every person that we came in contact was very nice and nice to our dog.  I will recommend this place for sure

If I could give zero stars I would. My appointment was at 5:15 and my GPS brought me to the other side of the shopping center so I was a little confused as to where Pet Co was because I’m never on the side of town and had no idea where the building was. I called them and let them know that I was in the parking lot and I was parking my car. I literally checked in at 5:18 and the doctor refused to see me. The girl at the front desk was so nice and kind and was able to get me checked in. Then a heavier set employee came out didn’t even greet. Me immediately was with her attitude and asked me about his shot records, which I mentioned to her all she said was, I’ve never heard of that before and walked away. And then I’m getting told that because I was three minutes late and even though I called ahead and told them that I was in their parking lot. She refused to see me. If this is the level of care that they give their customers, I wouldn’t trust my pet with them. Go somewhere else.

Waited an hour over my scheduled appointment to see the vet. Wants to do testing that has all come back negative in the past and told me if it all comes back negative, we just have to deal with the itching. I can't imagine there are no drugs to try for skin allergies in a dog. I just wanted to try a prescription for allergies. I did not get what I wanted. A waste of my time and money. Still looking for a good vet.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
everyone is so nice and it’s not to bad for all the prices
Everyone was so nice! Great spot for my kitten!
My dog was cooperative with the vets. She typically doesn’t like strangers, but the way the vets handled her made her feel comfortable and I greatly appreciate it!
Fantastic work , they were so gentle with my cat. happy cat , happy life.
It was amazing the staff were very helpful and helped explain the cost and what we needed to get done
The staff is always so great with Zeus! They did a great job on his surgery and when he comes in.

Dr. Camp was so nice and helpful, he had so much patience and I can really tell he really cares about my dogs well being which means a lot because it’s hard to trust doctors with your animals but he made me and my dog feel comfortable and he made sure my dog got all the help he needed for his seizures and Dr. camp was super helpful on giving me information as well, glad I got to meet him!
This location is far from home but very worth traveling to.  Staff all around is just amazing.
We appreciate your excellent rating! Thank you, and we hope to see you again soon.
This is a place with great people, they took good care of my cat. Thanks Vetco!

Took my dog in to get 2 vaccines but the vet insisted he get an updated heart worm test which I agreed to. She wouldn’t prescribe heart worm prevention medication without an updated test, that’s fine. His appointment was 2 weeks ago and since then I have called over 15 times trying to see if his results came back and no one ever answered or returned my call or emails. I finally spoke to someone last week who said the results hadn’t come back yet but the Dr would call me “the second results come back.” It’s been a week since that call and they finally got back to me today via text (after 7 more unanswered calls) and said that test results come back the same day so I should have got my results back 2 weeks ago. No one answers the phone or seems to know what’s going on.

Don't go here they won't take care of your animals they let me dog die and didn't help them at all at least could have put them down they struggled that day and then died at home even though I was asking for help and never got back to me told me to go somewhere else after paying 2k to do nothing
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

The whole staff is super friendly. Sage, the tech, was extremely patient with my dog and it was well appreciated that he offered options toward medications. The  doctor was great and check out was quick. Thank you to your VETCO team for their kindness!
Staff gives caring and total care. Everything is transparent as I was doubled charge by a another vet I feel safe bringing my fur babies here

Great service.  Andy was great.  I dropped a pill for my dog and he saw it in the parking lot and called me the next day.
Both Andy and the doctor were great

This was hands down the worst veterinary experience I’ve ever had.

I brought my dog Jordan in with an appointment, and from the moment I walked in, the receptionist treated me poorly just because I don’t speak perfect English. Despite having a scheduled visit, they hesitated to assist me and told me they would charge me a more expensive consultation fee for no clear reason.

They eventually put us in a tiny exam room and left us locked inside for nearly an hour with no explanation. The exam Jordan received was completely superficial rushed and careless  and then we were left waiting another hour, again with no updates. Naturally, my dog became distressed, started barking, and was visibly anxious.

I tried stepping out into the reception area to help him calm down and go potty. It helped a little until another dog briefly passed by, and they barked at each other (nothing aggressive, just normal barking). The receptionist yelled at me to make him be quiet, with a horrible attitude, constantly giving me dirty looks, and told me to take him back into the small room which is exactly where his stress had escalated in the first place. Once inside again, Jordan became more desperate and started pacing and barking because we were just waiting there like idiots.

When the vet finally came in (Dr. Kimberly), she stayed for less than a minute. I tried to ask her questions about my dog’s symptoms he had vomiting, bloody and mucousy stool, and had ingested water from a recently fumigated area  and she literally began walking out while I was speaking, completely ignoring me. I told her I had several questions, even the tech told her, and she just kept walking out as if none of it mattered. No diagnosis, no real explanation, no proper treatment plan. Nothing.

To make things worse, they charged me over $100 for a “phone call to a poisoning specialist” which they said was necessary since they didn’t know what to prescribe. But I wasn’t given any information about what was said on that call  if it even happened! They just charged me and moved on. Oh, and at one point, when my dog barked out of anxiety, the vet clapped loudly in his face and told him to stop barking. How is that professional behavior? He is a sweet, non-aggressive dog who was clearly overwhelmed by the chaos of this place.

In total, they charged me for:
•	A physical exam
•	A rectal exam
•	A fecal test
•	A “specialist call”
•	An overpriced consultation

And yet they offered ZERO solutions. The next day, they messaged me to say the fecal test was “perfect 😊.” When I replied saying my dog was still unwell, I was told I’d need to pay for another consultation if I wanted help.

This place is a complete scam, more focused on charging for useless services than helping animals. The only decent person there was the tech — everyone else lacked empathy, professionalism, and basic respect. I left angry, confused, and heartbroken.

I spent over two and a half hours at that clinic, and the actual vet saw my dog for barely one minute literally.
It’s honestly laughable… if it weren’t so frustrating and expensive.

Shameful clinic. I will never return. Absolutely do NOT recommend.
Excellent care for my Walter. Excellent doctor and staff. They were able to fit me in for a sick appointment the same day. I can't say enough great things. 10 out of 10.
Great first time visit at Vetco Total Care. Dr. Campagnolo was amazing with my very nervous dog Leroy! Sarah the nurse was great too!! Totally recommend!!

I took my dog when he injured his paw. The first visit was great. The last 2 visits were horrible. They charge $80 each time you bring your fur baby. Then they examine your dog and all the charges start coming. The Dr was beyond rude. They wanted to charge me $700 for an xray, another $300 for blood work, 240 to skin allergy test, plus all the meds which were not cheap. They do not offer a payment plan. I advised I do not have an extra $1300
That is when Dr advised me she could not help me. Without xray, blood work she could not tell me what was wrong with my fur baby. Then we go to pay their cashier was so slow. It took about 10 minted just to pay. Then the wait time to pay was ridiculously long. Would not recommend this office.

Used our free Vetco visit to have our 17 year dog checked out, it was her second time going to the vet ever , she hasn’t been since she was a puppy and got her shots, we were very nervous about taking her , bc it’s mainly just been her with us her whole life, so we didn’t know how she would be around new people , she did very well and I think it’s bc of the staff and environment there , it’s very clean, staff is very friendly, and I can’t say enough good things about the vet she saw, she growled at him at first but by the end of the visit they were friends , he checked everything on her , including
these masses she has on her body ( which most boxers are prone to) , her ears, eyes, teeth, everything!!! He answered all of our questions and made her experience very easy and nice!!! So
grateful we went here !
We you guys were good, but the front desk lady wasn’t very welcoming.

Booking was simple, the facility was clean & every staff member I interacted with was nice. I do wish there had been a more obvious notice provided that your pet has to have a rabies vaccine to be seen here - it was fine & they administered the vaccine while we were there since it was needed but just kind of a surprise expense.
Dr. Campagnolo & his staff are wonderful. They are always very courteous, and are very compassionate with the animals. I highly highly recommend them.

I had a wonderful experience during my recent visit to Vetco Happy Valley. Andy was absolutely amazing! He took great care of both my fur kiddos, showing kindness and patience throughout. He really listened to my concerns and answered all of my questions thoroughly. It was such a relief to receive such thoughtful and attentive care. I truly appreciate the great service Andy provided — thank you!
Dr. Tom Campagnolo and staff were excellent abd caring.

I had to say thank you to the staff for todays experience fast friendly service I was scared for my baby I’m due to her being in pain and all but the doctor and the technician was very informative answerd all my questions and took care of my baby girl thank you she will need more work done will be going back soon  but thank you  guys so much for helping me and my baby!
I scheduled an appointment for 3:30. I arrived at 3:20 got into an exam room at 3:45. I saw an assistant at 5pm. I m still waiting to see the vet after 1.5 hours of wair.

Amazing amazing amazing! Was nervous to take my puppy because he guards us in the room, and hasn’t had the best vet experiences in the past. Everyone at this clinic read my dog so well, understand his needs, and we’re so kind and intelligent. I cannot find the words to explain how great this visit was and how wonderful all the staff were, from the lady at the front desk, our vet tech, and the vet herself. Next, we’re bringing our other dog!

I had honestly a great experience with the whole team here! My dog shadow is a larger dog who gets so excited to meet new people and give hugs. Even though his size the employees treated him as an exciting new friend which I supper appreciate since we've been places where they could care less about the dog. I will definitely be bringing him back now that I'm at ease that he's treated like family.
My dog has a few issues to take care of, the staff and vet were very helpful.
I was put on hold immediately and for over 10 minutes
These folks are awesome. Thank you for your kindly services! God bless you!

Horrible service all the way around. Veterinarian is in there for a total of 2 seconds and did not acknowledge any concerns. The tech was way more helpful and answered a lot of our questions. On top of that, they overcharged and up sell EVERYTHING. Know that you can go to the Vetco Vaccination Clinic (same location-just different hours) for a cheaper package (around $200 cheaper) for the same services. They will tell you that their packages are more extensive exams but it truly is not. Beyond disappointed, especially as new puppy owners. Will be finding a new vet office.
Good people who really care about animals.

I took my Boston terrier Smoochie to Vetco Total Care Animal Hospital. They offer a free 1st visit for new clients. They offer shot clinics at all their locations but they only have two locations with actual in-store Vet clinics and Happy Valley is one of them. The facility is clean and modern the staff and doctors are friendly and helpful. I was hoping to get a refill of Apoquel for my dogs itchy allergies but they weren't comfortable prescribing without an expensive blood panel first which I declined but no worries I will just go back to Petsmart where we usually go I thought I would give Vetco a try for the purposes of this review and to check them out for comparison using their complimentary 1st time visit for new clients.
Vetco and Dr. Camp are the best my Barkley boy absolutely loves him and they take great care of him
Thank you for the positive review, Sajjad Satvati! We appreciate your support and are glad to know you had a positive experience with us.

So amazing Doctor Campagnolo who cares about your love's one.

I was not personally there but I was there for the aftermath of my own sisters kitten not being treated correctly and having to suffer the consequences of it after. I heard about the visits here and the vet clearly did not care about the kitten’s health really and just wanted the money and them out. It is truly devastating to have a vet give you a “solution” and for it to just make your pet worse and lead to their own body now fighting itself because a vet didn’t put in the time to actually help. This is the worst and deserves the one star.

I’m only giving this Vetco 1 star because the staff were friendly. But I WILL NOT give this Vetco more than one star. My reason? Because I took my 7 month old kitten (who wasn’t eating, drinking, playing, had pale gums, etc.) to this vet 2 separate times. Both times I was told he had only a minor condition I needed to treat. I payed a good couple hundred dollars. After taking my kitten here a few times, I realized he was getting worse. I brought him to a different vet because clearly this vet did not know what was wrong with my kitten. The new vet I took him to, told me that my kitten had Liver Failure and Jaundice. Only giving him a day or two to live. The treatment was way too expensive and i needed to give that money right then and there in order to save my cat. I had no time to surrender him to a shelter to possibly get him the care he needed nor the money to pay for this treatment. So, my cat passed away. And it’s on these guys’ hands. If I had known sooner that my kitten’s liver was failing, i would have had the time to surrender him or get the money for his treatment. I would absolutely love to sue this Vetco! Or at least get the vet that examined my kitten fired! I don’t understand how you went to school to know what’s wrong with my animal and yet, you had no idea he had Liver Failure???  I payed you hundreds of dollars just for you to basically kill my cat. If you’re thinking about bringing your animal here for an injury or illness, I DO NOT RECOMMEND!!
Above and beyond!

The veterinarians assistant and the veterinarian were both extremely kind patient and explained everything they were doing while they were doing it. They were very gentle with my cat and it was an overall wonderful experience. I will definitely come back to this location even though it's far for me.

Both the Dr and assistant were great,  friendly, helpful with better cost options and saw me in a timely matter which is huge to me.
